alternatives.option: trusting the lane reports, which is exactly how a matrix stops being evidence

context: Rewrote the foundation matrix from the merged tree with measured counts and appended the D39 merge log entry; every unavailable and todo left honest.
rationale: lane reports were measured in worktrees before the merge and three of them changed once the lanes met (the 65 lane-04 fixture failures alone would have made a copied number wrong). Cost: one extra full acceptance run. Alternative rejected: trusting the lane reports, which is exactly how a matrix stops being evidence.
summary: Rebuilt every matrix count by running the suite against the merged tree rather than transcribing the lanes' self-reported numbers
